instruction.text: Read the end of the story and answer the questions.

atoms.text: So what was that mysterious noise? The stag turns nervously, and then, a second later, he’s running. He’s being hunted by a panther! He runs and runs, taking sharp turns to switch directions, his nimble legs carrying him safely away from the panther.

All of a sudden, his antlers get caught on a branch! “Oh no!” yells the stag. The panther approaches as the stag shakes his head, trying to unstick his antlers. He yanks with his whole body, his hooves and legs planted strong in the dirt.
atoms.sound: ssml: All of a sudden, his antlers get caught on a branch! <voice voice='m1'>“Oh no!”</voice> yells the Stag. The panther approaches as the stag shakes his head, trying to unstick his antlers. He yanks with his whole body, his hooves and legs planted strong in the dirt.

atoms.text: He breaks free and his swift legs carry him once more to safety. He breathes heavily and thinks, “I am so happy that my legs are so thin! They are fast and practical and saved me today.” The legs that he had criticised had saved him, and his beautiful antlers had almost doomed him.

atoms.a: Which animal was chasing the stag?
How did the stag try to escape the panther?
b: ++by taking sharp turns to switch directions
by running as fast as he could
by hiding in an unassuming spot

atoms.a: How did the stag almost get caught?
b: The panther got tired of chasing him.

atoms.a: What saved the stag from the panther?
What is the lesson of this story?
b: ++We should not value beauty more than usefulness.
The early bird gets the worm.
